newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chemical fibre maker Kaidi moves into drugs.
newsitem.headline: Chemical fibre maker Kaidi moves into drugs.

text.p: Chemical fibre producer Guizhou Kaidi Co Ltd is diversifying into pharmaceutical production in an effort to minimise the impact from the stagnant chemical fibre market, a company spokesman said on Friday.

He told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin that Kaidi's 30-million-yuan pharmaceutical plant started partial operations last month and should post net earnings of some 10 million yuan next year on full operation.
He said the plant's products are being tested by the authorities and should be sold in the domestic market this month.

Kaidi said in its interim report for 1996 that, under Chinese accounting standards, it posted a net loss of 1.15 million yuan in the first half against net earnings of 1.12 million yuan in the year-earlier period.
Kaidi said in its annual report for 1995 that it lost 9.48 million yuan in 1995, compared with net earnings of 12.65 million yuan the previous year.
